summary: The frozen helper passes its14 focused tests and all ordinary recorded-receipt compatibility checks, including actual E811 executed UNKNOWN/empty bank versus zero-call refusal and full E809/E810 ordering/raw preservation without CV recomputation. However, two independent sparse-array probes violate the exact E808 malformed-input contract: branchless refusals accept a missing short-ID slot and project an undefined declaration rather than UNKNOWN with projection:null. Require a minimal dense-label validation repair and pure regression tests; no helper source was changed by this reviewer. The reported bare-suite17 failures remain unclassified pending root's untouched-base control. No scientific acceptance follows.

requiredAmendments.source: group.mjs labels / groupProblem / NOT_EXECUTED declaration path
requiredAmendments.finding: labels uses Array.every(named), which skips sparse holes. For orderedShortStationIds=new Array(1), labels returns true, length is nonzero and Set size equals length. On a valid branchless refusal the helper does not resolve station IDs, so it returns PROJECTED_EVIDENCE_ONLY/NOT_EXECUTED with an undefined short ID. A partially sparse ['unverified-short', <hole>] list behaves the same. This violates nonempty named IDs and the one malformed-input/no-validated-projection policy even though refusal IDs are correctly unverified semantically.
requiredAmendments.actual: PROJECTED_EVIDENCE_ONLY/NOT_EXECUTED, with a projected declaration containing undefined; JSON encodes that slot as null. Full raw outputs and sparse own-property metadata are retained in counterexample.json.
requiredAmendments.requestedRepair: Validate every declared label index densely before projection, so absent slots cannot pass the named-ID predicate. Keep scope to label validation and pure tests; no CV, numeric criterion, association or source/recipe behavior change.
requiredRegressionChecks: A one-hole short list and a valid-plus-hole list on a branchless UNKNOWN refusal return the common invalid-input envelope and projection:null.
The same malformed declarations are invalid on branchless DISABLED and executed shapes as well.
Ordinary dense explicit ID lists, valid unverified refusal declarations, empty-bank executed UNKNOWN and real E809/E810 order/raw fields remain unchanged.
requiredAmendments.boundary: The counterexample corrupts validation of caller declaration metadata; it does not invent measured rows, change receipt bytes, or execute CV. That narrower impact does not waive the admitted contract.
